source_families.label: Regulators, legislation, and official enforcement
source_families.purpose: Find binding rules, official guidance, consultations, and enforcement facts with explicit jurisdiction.
source_families.acceptable_evidence: Primary government, regulator, or legislation source.

source_families.label: Standards and test-method owners
source_families.purpose: Find scope boundaries, terminology, test conditions, revisions, and application limits.
source_families.acceptable_evidence: Official standards-body pages, published scopes, or original test-method institutions.

source_families.label: Equipment and process owners
source_families.purpose: Find original interface requirements for forklifts, conveyors, AS/RS, AGVs, wrappers, washers, racks, sensors, and related processes.
source_families.acceptable_evidence: Original equipment manuals, technical documentation, or system-owner guidance; marketing claims alone are not evidence.

source_families.label: Logistics, carrier, and pool operators
source_families.purpose: Find route, receiving, return-loop, container, securing, inspection, and ownership handoff requirements.
source_families.acceptable_evidence: Original carrier, intermodal, pool-operator, or logistics-institution documents with stated scope.

source_families.label: Original industry research and institutions
source_families.purpose: Find durable operating problems, research findings, and implementation constraints that can be traced to the originating institution.
source_families.acceptable_evidence: Original institutional report, survey methodology, technical paper, or member guidance; search summaries are leads only.

portfolio_axes.label: Load, support, and structural evidence
buyer_questions: Does the evidence match the real load distribution and support condition?
Where does a rating or test scope stop?

portfolio_axes.label: Forklift and pallet-truck interfaces
buyer_questions: Will the actual truck, fork, wheel path, load centre, and route work together?
What equipment change requires re-approval?

portfolio_axes.label: Storage, racking, and stacking
buyer_questions: What support geometry, dwell time, temperature, and stack condition control approval?
What failure should stop storage release?

portfolio_axes.label: Automation and machine interfaces
buyer_questions: Which pallet surfaces, tolerances, sensors, transfers, or controls must be validated?
What line change invalidates the prior trial?

portfolio_axes.label: Hygiene and controlled environments
buyer_questions: What cleanability, contamination, zoning, temperature, or material evidence is required?
Who releases the pallet back into controlled use?

portfolio_axes.label: Transport, export, and securing
buyer_questions: Which pallet facts transfer to the unit-load or route approval and which do not?
Who owns the handoff at loading and receiving?

portfolio_axes.label: Reuse, pooling, and traceability
buyer_questions: How are ownership, identity, rotation, loss, return, and retirement controlled?
What record changes a reuse claim?

portfolio_axes.label: Materials, environment, and change control
buyer_questions: Which resin, recycled-content, chemical, weather, or temperature condition changes performance?
What supplier change requires confirmation?

portfolio_axes.label: Safety, fire, and electrostatic conditions
buyer_questions: What site-specific hazard review is required beyond a pallet specification?
Which claim must remain with EHS, insurer, equipment owner, or authority?

portfolio_axes.label: Procurement, verification, and handoff
buyer_questions: What evidence should the buyer request, test, record, accept, or reject?
Which party owns the final decision?

open_query_lanes.label: Regulation and compliance change
open_query_lanes.search_focus: New or revised rules, official consultations, enforcement guidance, and standards changes affecting pallets, reusable transport packaging, hygiene, safety, or trade.
query_patterns: plastic pallet transport packaging official guidance {current_year}
reusable transport packaging pallet enforcement consultation official
pallet standard scope revision official site

open_query_lanes.label: Warehouse handling and safety
open_query_lanes.search_focus: Forklift, pallet-jack, racking, loading, damage, manual handling, and workplace transport changes with a defined buyer decision.
query_patterns: palletized load forklift load centre visibility official guidance
pallet handling racking stacking loading incident technical guidance
plastic pallet pallet truck dock route safety manual

open_query_lanes.label: Automation and operating change
open_query_lanes.search_focus: Conveyors, AS/RS, sensing, wrapping, robotics, traceability, and process changes that alter pallet selection or approval.
query_patterns: plastic pallet conveyor ASRS AGV interface technical manual
pallet transfer sensor tolerance equipment integration guide
empty pallet dispenser denesting palletizer original technical documentation

open_query_lanes.label: Materials, circularity, and claims

reusable plastic transport packaging lifecycle original research
polymer pallet chemical temperature performance test guidance
